Volunteer with the Health Department
Volunteer Options
Short Term or Public Health Students : Students or those interested in public health, or shadowing health department staff. Email Patty Krause to inquire about opportunities.
Volunteer in an Emergency : Join the MI Volunteer Registry as a Washtenaw County affiliated volunteer. Follow the tips in the next section.
Washtenaw County MRC : Join the MRC to volunteer with health department non-emergency activities/events, participate in training and exercises. The MRC is currently closed. All county affiliated volunteers will be notified via the MI Volunteer Registry when the MRC opens. Follow the tips in the next section.
MI Volunteer Registry
This system provides license and background checks and tracks essential information we may need in a response. The MI Volunteer Registry is managed by the Michigan Department of Health and Human Services. All emergency and MRC volunteers must complete a profile in the MI Volunteer Registry. If you have questions regarding the MI Volunteer Registry, click the "Registry FAQ" tab on the left-hand side of the webpage.
Complete a profile in the MI Volunteer Registry . How to add Washtenaw County to your profile:
Click the "Add Organizations" link (it has the orange plus next to it).
Next, click the plus sign to the left of "County Affiliation" to see the names of the counties.
Select the box next to Washtenaw County , so a checkmark appears in the box.
Then press "Select" in the bottom right-hand corner.
Washtenaw County Medical Reserve Corps (MRC)
The MRC is a national network of volunteers, organized locally to improve the health and safety of their communities. The Washtenaw County MRC is housed within the Washtenaw County Health Department and serves as the volunteer unit for the department. This group is for medical and non-medical volunteers. MRC members can volunteer in a variety of ways.
Note : The Washtenaw County MRC is not accepting new volunteer applications. For more details, view the Join the Washtenaw County MRC page .
